name: license-report
description: Know what licences you ship: scan a Node.js project's installed dependencies (direct and transitive, npm, yarn or pnpm) and get every package's licence normalised to SPDX, classed as permissive, weak copyleft, strong copyleft, proprietary or unknown. GPL/AGPL and missing licences are flagged until you review them; fix a licence by hand and add a note. Export an Excel report for legal and a THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt to ship with your app. Runs locally on node_modules; no online lookup or API keys.

description_i18n.en: Know what licences you ship: scan a Node.js project's installed dependencies (direct and transitive, npm, yarn or pnpm) and get every package's licence normalised to SPDX, classed as permissive, weak copyleft, strong copyleft, proprietary or unknown. GPL/AGPL and missing licences are flagged until you review them; fix a licence by hand and add a note. Export an Excel report for legal and a THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt to ship with your app. Runs locally on node_modules; no online lookup or API keys.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 弄清楚你的产品里带了哪些许可证：扫描 Node.js 项目已安装的依赖（直接和间接依赖，npm、yarn、pnpm 都支持），把每个包的许可证规范成 SPDX 名称，并分成宽松、弱 copyleft、强 copyleft、专有和未知几类。GPL/AGPL 和没写许可证的包会被标出，直到你审核过为止；可以手动修正许可证并写备注。导出给法务看的 Excel 报告，以及随产品发布的 THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt。在本地读取 node_modules，不联网查询，无需 API 密钥。
